title: Tree-search cost cap — declared manifest fields wired to an enforced limiter
acceptance_condition: Exercise the real executor with concurrent and in-flight cost reservations, candidate/time limits and explicit invocation checks.
finding_addressed: the named cap fields were not found consumed by a limiter in the inspected runtime paths

implementation.rationale: no JS dispatcher routes tree-search: management-api/ and mcp/servers/ contain no tree-search invocation path (only scripts/agentbox-config-validate.js W051/W052 validation and management-api/lib/system-manifest.js gate catalogue). The skill is orchestration-only, driven as a sequence of short-lived tool calls, so the enforcement boundary is a callable limiter with durable, lock-guarded state — which belongs in services/agentbox-ops beside the existing token_audit cost accounting.
implementation.module: services/agentbox-ops/src/cost_cap/ (mod.rs config+limiter+typed errors, ledger.rs flock-guarded durable state)

documented_defaults.note: an absent field falls back to the documented default and is named in CapConfig.defaulted; there is no unlimited mode

implementation.concurrency_safety: every check-and-admit is a read-modify-write of the JSON ledger performed while holding an exclusive rustix flock on it — atomic across threads AND processes, never a read-then-write
implementation.reservation_model: cost is reserved BEFORE dispatch and held for the branch's lifetime; settle() releases it on both the success and failure paths; an unsettled hold expires at per_branch_timeout_s and is charged its FULL estimate so a crashed branch cannot hand back budget it may have spent
implementation.skill_wiring: skills/tree-search-coder/SKILL.md and references/algorithm.md §Enforced cost cap make reserve-before-dispatch and settle-after-completion mandatory steps; references/exemplars.md exemplar 3 now shows the limiter's refusal rather than an agent-side cost check

tests.note: cross-PROCESS: 10 concurrent `tree-search-cap reserve --estimate 0.20` processes against a 0.50 cap admit exactly 2 and refuse 8; outstanding holds measured at 0.40 <= cap

not_covered: byte-identical-when-off build evidence for the disabled package/supervisor footprint (ADR-2020's other half; no image rebuild ran)
no provider, model orchestration or image rebuild was executed
